Published - November 07, 2026 11:07 am IST - WELLINGTON, New Zealand
India’s captain Shubman Gill along with New Zealand’s captain Mitchell Santner. File | Photo Credit: PTI
India captain Shubman Gill won a delayed toss and chose to bowl on Saturday (November 7, 2026) in the second one-day cricket international against New Zealand, a match reduced by rain to 47 overs per side.
Also read | IND vs NZ second ODI: Pace heavy India looks to extend advantage over New Zealand
A wet outfield caused the toss to be delayed by an hour and both captains indicated they would bowl first in humid conditions on a pitch which has been covered for the last two days.
Both team are unchanged from the first match in Auckland which India won comfortably by five wickets with 56 balls remaining.
That match which was also rain-affected was highlighted by an innings of 74 by Virat Kohli. Kohli celebrated his 38th birthday in Wellington on Thursday.
Rain fell in the morning Saturday (November 7), dampening the outfield. Heavier rain is forecast along with possible thunderstorms.
New Zealand: Will Young, Tim Seifert, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham, Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner (captain), Nathan Smith, Kyle Jamieson, Jacob Duffy, Blair Tickner.
India: Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill (captain), Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, Axar Patel, K.L. Rahul, Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Arshdeep Singh, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar.
